A <c:ffff00>support type<c> <c:ffff00>skill<c>: the ability to handle <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> with
mechanisms for setting up <c:ffff00>objects<c>. <c:ffff00>Actions<c> that
place <c:ffff00>Traps<c> and <c:ffff00>Plants<c> belong to it.

The higher the <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c>, the faster <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> are, and the higher <c:ffff00>defense power<c> and
<c:ffff00>evasion power<c> become.
On Set-up {{part|pl}}, the <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> stat rises when the
<c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> fills.
